flows.exit.immovable_ratio.formula: 评估值：固定资产净额 276,932.11 ÷ 资产总额 283,155.57（RMB 万元，pdf 72）= 97.80%；固定资产几乎全是房屋建筑物（pdf 52：账面净值 RMB1,138,452,196.55）

present.exit_route.quote: the 99% equity interests in KIC will be transferred from Top Victory to the Limited Partnership at the consideration of approximately RMB2,668,000,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$2,925,000,000).

event.exit.quote: the 99% equity interests in KIC will be transferred from Top Victory to the Limited Partnership at the consideration of approximately RMB2,668,000,000
